item.title: Ukraine’s Receiver Turns Russian Drone Video Into Intel
item.description: Kyiv startup’s 10‑oz D·Vision SDR captures unencrypted video from Russian Molniya drones, giving Ukrainian units real‑time visual intel on enemy UAVs.
